```  
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of providing information regarding a product using a computing device, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user using a user device; and storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user.

(Currently Amended) Claim 23: The method of claim 19, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of a user identified by the second unique identifier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for a user using a user device.
```
